TOP: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited this year
Barracuda ESG root flaws and N-able's 33 zero-days under attack
Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 split cyber offense from defense
AWS Nitro Sandboxes give every EKS pod its own VM

P.h: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
P.p: TLDR InfoSec says Google shipped an emergency Chrome update for a bug attackers are already exploiting. It is a use-after-free in the browser's XML parser that can lead to arbitrary code execution.
P.s: This is the eighth Chrome zero-day exploited this year, per the newsletter. Update Chrome and other Chromium browsers now and confirm managed fleets have restarted onto the fixed build.

items.h: Barracuda ESG flaws exploited for root access
items.d: Two bugs patched last week are under active attack: an auth weakness that alters global config and an unauthenticated OS command injection running as root. Barracuda says both need admin console access, so keep it off the internet.

items.h: N-able pulls N-central offline over 33 zero-days
items.d: Researcher Sean Bales disclosed Able2Shell with proof-of-concept exploits, including root-level RCE. N-able found no active exploitation, but watchTowr saw attempts against honeypots. On-premises customers were told to shut servers down.

items.h: Turla's Cereal turns Exchange servers into C2
items.d: ESET found a passive backdoor using OWA, Autodiscover and ActiveSync paths, plus a transport agent hook copying mail tied to NATO and EU addresses. Seen in Kazakhstan and Romania. Check System32\wbem for fake DLLs.
Attackers entered internal systems in January and copied files between January 18 and February 8, the company says.

P.h: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 split cyber work in two
P.p: TLDR InfoSec reports Anthropic's two models share one underlying model. Mythos targets security work and found 10.2% more vulnerabilities than Opus 5.5 in a 1,829-CVE rediscovery test. Fable blocks high-risk cyber tasks such as pentesting and exploit generation.
P.s: TLDR IT adds that Cisco will bring Claude Mythos into its AI Defense platform for authorized red teaming of enterprise AI agents. Fable's false-positive blocks fell by about 60%, per Anthropic.

P.h: AWS Nitro Sandboxes put each EKS pod in its own microVM
P.p: TLDR DevOps says AWS Nitro Sandboxes give Amazon EKS pods hardware-enforced isolation by running each in a lightweight virtual machine. One line in the pod spec enables it, with no image or pipeline changes.
P.s: An isolated mode gives standard protection and a confidential mode adds cryptographic attestation. Pair it with the MCP guidance in the same issue: servers lack built-in auth and rate limits, so put an AI gateway in front.
